### A config-driven agent network

A broker sends each question to specialist agents and holds risky answers at a human approval gate. The roster, the prompts and every agent's reply live in one XML file, so the network is data, not code.

A live run needs your own OpenAI API key and costs a fraction of a cent a question. Its 19 tests run against a stub model, with no key and no cost.
